cases.prompt: Create a Surface Contact Viewer at /contacts. Define a contact with string id, required name, optional email, and required Boolean active fields. Look it up by string id, display name, email, and active, and include empty and not-found states.
acceptance: The result is valid Surface 0.1 KDL.
The result contains exactly one application and at least one screen.
The application has no version property.
The contact entity declares fields as typed child nodes using only (string) and (boolean).
Required fields have no modifier, and only email uses the bare optional modifier.
The query declares a private entity containing a string id field and references it with input (entity).
The query references the global contact with returns (entity)"contact" and missing=#null.
The screen uses use (query)"contactById", and all references resolve.
The screen contains exactly one empty and one notFound state.
The result does not introduce syntax from a later rung.

cases.prompt: Add an optional string phone field to a valid Contact Viewer entity and display it after email. Preserve its comments, context, query, states, and unrelated content.
acceptance: The entity adds exactly one (string) phone field with the bare optional modifier.
The normal screen section adds field phone immediately after field email.
The lookup query and both screen states remain unchanged.
The existing comment, context node, and unrelated content are preserved.
The result remains valid Surface 0.1 KDL.

cases.prompt: Diagnose a Contact Viewer whose id field uses the unsupported required modifier, whose returns value omits the entity annotation, whose private entity shadows a global entity, whose input references an undeclared entity, which projects an undeclared phone field, and which is missing its notFound state.
acceptance: The response identifies all six validation problems.
The response distinguishes valid KDL from valid Surface.
Every suggested correction uses only released rung-1 through rung-3 syntax.
